title: docs: clarify hosted MCP servers
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Uses Gen-hosted MCP endpoints as the canonical URLs
- Lists Pollinations, FFmpeg, and Exa Search with their purpose and tools
- Groups Pollinations tools into discovery, generation, and account sections
- Clarifies shared authentication, permissions, billing, and resource-link behavior

Tests:
- `npm run typecheck` in `gen.pollinations.ai`
- Biome and `git diff --check`

gist.headline: MCP map, freshly labeled
gist.blurb: The hosted MCP garden has proper signposts now. Pollinations, FFmpeg, and Exa Search are all listed with the tools they bring to the picnic.
gist.summary: Added a dedicated hosted-MCP guide using Gen-hosted canonical endpoints, documenting Pollinations, FFmpeg, and Exa Search tools plus shared authentication, permissions, billing, and resource-link behavior.
gist.impact: Developers can now connect agents to the right hosted MCP server with clearer tool groupings for Pollinations discovery, generation, and account tasks.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden directory for hosted MCP servers: Polli acts as a friendly guide beside three labeled little terminals for Pollinations, FFmpeg, and Exa Search. Paths branch into discovery, generation, and account flowerbeds, while glowing shared keys and resource-link vines show that the servers share access rules.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light-blue wings, and a tiny librarian scarf, pointing at a garden map of three chunky retro terminals labeled "POLLINATIONS", "FFMPEG", and "EXA"; paths lead through flowerbeds labeled "DISCOVER", "GENERATE", and "ACCOUNT", with shared key-shaped vines linking them. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, subtle CRT glow and pixel-font text.
